title: Autodesk AC1021 TABLE sample source attribution and bounded implementation readiness
scope: Determine whether the existing Autodesk-hosted AC1021 TABLE sample can qualify one precise producer-release profile for P5-I, and define the smallest safe implementation path without promoting generic AC1021 support.

producerAttribution.method: Embedded AcDb:AppInfo metadata extracted from the exact source by GNU LibreDWG 0.14 using `dwgread -O minJSON`; corroborated by SummaryInfo and FileDepList metadata.
producerAttribution.primaryMapping: Autodesk ACADVER documentation maps product version 17.0s to AutoCAD 2007: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2019/ENU/AutoCAD-Core/files/GUID-793238B6-F8B8-4D20-BB3A-001700AECD75.htm
producerAttribution.conclusion: The source is an Autodesk-published AC1021 drawing whose embedded product metadata identifies AutoCAD 2007. AC1021 alone covers later releases too; this embedded release evidence is required to select the bounded profile.
producerAttribution.limit: The exact AppInfo section is now decoded by libdxfrw's bounded classifier; see the linked implementation receipt. This establishes only the producer profile. TABLE field spans, graph closure, output, fresh readback, and native meaning remain open.

primaryLayoutAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.use: R21-R27 AppInfo layout for implementing a strictly bounded metadata classifier.
Specifies the TABLE format until R21 and states that AutoCAD 2007 cells contain either one text or one block; the AutoCAD 2008 change is explicitly unresolved in the specification.

primaryLayoutAuthority.boundary: This authority supports the AutoCAD 2007 legacy cell profile only. It does not define the changed AutoCAD 2008 TABLE cell layout.

independentSemanticReadback.limit: This is an independent typed-value readback for the exact source. ACadSharp remains a peer implementation, not DWG wire-layout authority; do not use peer agreement to settle 2008/2009 layouts.

implementationReadiness.currentCodeConstraint: DRW::Version AC1021 alone does not distinguish AutoCAD 2007 from 2008/2009. A bounded AppInfo classifier and internal profile route are implemented; TABLE field-span and output proof remain open.

completedSlices.result: The exact source is classified as AutoCAD 2007; unknown or malformed metadata remains unqualified. Focused generated classifier and TABLE selectors pass.
Documented text-cell overrides are retained for the exact profile. Two final-row alignment values remain incomplete pending resolution of the raw-RS versus BitShort boundary conflict.

orderedSteps: Resolve the exact source's raw-RS alignment 42049 versus BitShort candidate 6 at cells [8,0] and [9,0] with source field-boundary evidence. ACadSharp reads the candidate meaning as MiddleRight, but peer semantics cannot overrule ODA §20.4.96.1.

For the exact AutoCAD 2007 profile, trace and bind each cell's type, value span, style/string fields, handle roles, cell count, TABLE override tail, and following-object boundary against ODA §20.4.96.1 and the source. Keep all other AC1021 releases semantically incomplete and retain the anonymous-block display fallback.
Add profile-aware unknown-source, truncation, wrong-role, and boundary controls. Do not commit the Autodesk DWG or derived fixtures.

Prove failure preserves state and corrected same-writer retry; verify strict selected-table ASCII/Binary output and fresh ACadSharp readback. The whole source currently refuses strict output for two typed proxy graphics, so qualify selected TABLE output separately. Keep unrelated whole-drawing FIELD/FIELDLIST refusal attributed to its own open gates.
implementationReadiness.closureStillRequires: Source-span and graph-role proof, successful strict output/readback for the selected TABLE profile, 2D fallback preservation, and independent cell-meaning comparison. No AC1021-wide support claim follows from this source.

nextAction: Continue with source-bound AutoCAD 2007 TABLE field-span and following-object proof. Do not wait for the GUI session or for unrelated AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 witnesses.
